Sauce & Condiment

Balsamic Vinaigrette

About This Entry

Balsamic vinaigrette balances the sweet, syrupy depth of aged balsamic vinegar against olive oil, dressing salads and roasted vegetables alike — that sweet-tart balance pairs with Chenin Blanc.
